description: Wand builder/spender - wand attacks run off Spirit through ranged attack power, Distortion spells are the payoff, and only one Continuum can be active at a time.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_chronomancer__artificer.txt: 'Closest to a builder/spender ranged caster: a stack-driven Arcane Mage crossed with the Essence loop of an Evoker.' Two things shape this tree. First, Echo Fragments cannot be a resource, so the build-and-spend rhythm is carried by cooldowns and six ability unlocks rather than a bar. Second, the wand line is authored as ranged_damage so Wand Expert's Spirit conversion is real - which splits the spec's damage across two engine paths, physical (wand) and arcane (Distortion), and is why crit and critical damage appear here in both flavours while arcane_spell_damage appears only on the spell side. Stat priority is Spell Hit > Spell Penetration > Spirit > Crit > Haste > Spell Power > Intellect, and Spell Power sits that low precisely because most of this kit is not spell damage at all.

nodes.name: Artificer's Empowerment
nodes.description: Increases your Spirit by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Spirit by 8%', 3 ranks. With Wand Expert below, this is the whole gearing story: 'Artificer's Empowerment raises Spirit and Wand Expert converts part of it into ranged attack power. Nearly the whole kit runs off one stat.'

nodes.name: Wand Master
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Wand of Time and Artificer's Wand by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Wand of Time and Artificer's Wand by 10%.'

nodes.name: Discovery
nodes.description: Your damaging casts have a 30% chance to grant you 5 haste and 2% physical critical strike chance for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Artificer's Wand and Wand of Time now grants Discovery for 30 seconds, stacking 4 times. At 3 stacks, your next Wand of Time or Artificer's Wand causes an additional Arcane hit.' A proc payload cannot stack or count to a threshold, so the stack build is a flat window. crit_chance_physical, not spell - the wand line rolls its crits off hit_chance_physical and crit_chance_physical, because ranged_damage is resolved as physical in Ability._roll_crit.

nodes.name: Concentrated Fate
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the effectiveness of your Echo Fragments by 20%.' Echo Fragments are not a resource (see the module docstring), and every spell in the spec is either a fragment generator or a fragment spender, so the honest reading of 'all your fragments are worth more' is all your damage. all_damage also happens to be the only key that covers BOTH halves of this spec - arcane_spell_damage misses the wand line entirely.

nodes.name: Artificer's Wand
nodes.description: Teaches Artificer's Wand, two quick wand strikes with no cooldown.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Artificer's Wand is your filler and main Echo Fragment generator.' The spec does not work without it, so it is the first unlock.

nodes.name: Wand Expert
nodes.description: Grants ranged attack power equal to 5% of your Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: CoA's level-20 free passive: 'Increases your ranged attack power by 100% of your Spirit.' A real conversion against the shared STAT_CONVERSION maps, and the reason the wand line is authored as ranged_damage - this is what feeds it. 25% at 5/5 rather than CoA's 100%, because this engine's ranged attack power is a much larger multiplier on a wand roll than CoA's is.

nodes.name: Bronze Echoes
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of Artificer's Wand by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cast time of Artificer's Wand by -0.2 sec.' No cast times; a filler you press constantly is gated by its cost instead. Positive is the reduction.

nodes.name: Caverns of Time
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Discordance by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Discordance now generates 1 Echo Fragment', and Discordance is pressed on cooldown in both of this spec's rotations.

nodes.name: Singularity Core
nodes.description: Teaches Singularity Core, the single-target Continuum.
nodes._source: CoA: 'keep Singularity Core and Decomposition up' on a boss. The default Continuum.

nodes.name: Shatter Echo
nodes.description: Teaches Shatter Echo, the spec's burst spender.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Spend banked fragments on Shatter Echo, your main burst spender.'

nodes.name: Elder Wand
nodes.description: Increases your physical critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Wand attacks now have a 30% chance to increase the damage of Artificer's Wand against the target by 3%, stacking 10 times.' A ten-stack ramp on one target is not expressible; crit on the wand line is, and Critical Strike is third in this spec's stat priority.

nodes.name: Crystal Cannon
nodes.description: Your damaging casts have a 30% chance to fire the Crystal Cannon.
nodes._source: CoA's level-30 free passive: 'Casting Discordance now unleashes the Crystal Cannon, launching 2 quick lesser Wand attacks at the enemy.' A real free cast via cast_ability; the trigger is any damaging cast rather than Discordance specifically, since procs cannot name the ability that fired them.

nodes.name: Flux Emitter
nodes.description: Teaches Flux Emitter, the cleave Continuum.
nodes._source: CoA: 'On a pack, swap your Continuum to Flux Emitter for its 3-4-target cleave.'

nodes.name: Hyperwand
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shatter Echo by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage and critical damage of your Shatter Echo by 30%.'

nodes.name: Infinity Stone
nodes.description: Increases your physical and spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3% ... In addition, increases your critical strike chance by 3%.' Only the personal half can exist - talent effects never reach a party - so the node covers both of the spec's two crit pools instead.

nodes.name: Splitting Time
nodes.description: Increases the damage your area spells deal by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Crystal Cannon now strikes 2 additional nearby enemies', and Sporadic Incantations' 'Your Flux Emitter now strikes 1 additional enemy'. Target counts are fixed on the ability, so the extra targets become harder area damage - which is also CoA's honest verdict on this spec: 'No uncapped AoE.'

nodes.name: Paradox Cannon
nodes.description: Teaches Paradox Cannon, which banks Mana between pulls.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Bank ahead with Paradox Cannon between pulls.'

nodes.name: Conduction Burst
nodes.description: Increases your Arcane spell damage by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Shatter Echo now deals 20% additional damage while a Continuum spell is active.' The Continuum condition cannot be read, so it is the spec's Arcane damage - which covers Shatter Echo and Arc Collision but deliberately not the wand line (ranged_damage resolves as physical).

nodes.name: Reverse Engineering
nodes.description: Your casts have a 15% chance to grant you 8 haste for 3 turns and return a little Mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Periodic damage and healing now has a 15% chance to increase your haste by 15% for 6 seconds and grant allies Replenishment.' Replenishment reaches the party, which a proc cannot, so the mana goes to the Chronomancer.

nodes.name: Intuition
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your critical strikes by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA's level-50 free passive: 'Increases your critical damage by 25%.' Both pools, because this spec crits with both.

nodes.name: Time Is A Circle
nodes.description: Your Continuum spells last 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: CoA's level-40 free passive: 'Casting Wand of Time now extends the duration of your Continuum spells by 3 sec.' Extension on cast has no hook, so the Continuums simply last longer.

nodes.name: Magic Sensitivity
nodes.description: Grants 5 spell penetration per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Shatter Echo now increases the enemy's damage taken from you by 10%.' A damage-taken debuff is inert against creatures, and this spec's stat priority puts Spell Penetration second, so the node grants the stat the reference says to gear for.

nodes.name: Pulse Driver
nodes.description: Shatter Echo hits half again as hard, and your critical strikes land heavier still. +15% Shatter Echo damage, +10% physical critical damage and +10% spell critical damage.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Singularity Core now increases the damage of Shatter Echo while its active by 30% and allows Shatter Echo to trigger its damage.' The Continuum condition is not readable, so the payoff is unconditional and smaller - which also matches what CoA says the spec is for: 'Bank Echo Fragments into an empowered Singularity Core, dump them on Shatter Echo, and the sustained spike holds up. Single-target is the identity here.'
